g.text: Context length: admission matters more exactly where the tier matters less C2, 600 mm²/die/tier, 3.16 GB, batch 8, mean output 30

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All seven points at 64 steps with dead-KV saturated at 100%. A 24-step run understated 16k/32k by exactly its 75% dead fraction, which the general form predicts.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Trace replay of a synthetic aperiodic ledger, not a measurement. Absolute reduction falls because a fixed 3.16 GB tier covers a growing stream; the share rises because more of a first-fill tier is KV that dies.
